notes: S. 850 amends the Northern Border Security Review Act (PL 114-267, fetched as referencedSource bill-114-s-1808) to (1) convert the one-time 180-day threat analysis into a recurring deliverable (180 days after this Act + every 3 years), (2) add a new sector-level apprehension-trends paragraph, (3) add a Northern Border strategy-update subsection (18 months + every 5 years, incorporating the latest analysis), (4) add a classified-briefing subsection (30 days after each analysis), and (5) direct CBP Air and Marine Operations to develop performance measures (180 days) — all with no additional funds. Every figure (180 days, 3 years, 18 months, 5 years, 30 days), every actor (DHS Secretary, CBP Executive Assistant Commissioner of Air and Marine Operations), every subsection/paragraph redesignation ((c)->(d), (2)/(3)/(4)->(3)/(4)/(5), new (c)/(e)/paragraph (2)), and the six-committee 'appropriate congressional committees' definition all match source exactly; no figure error, direction inversion, wrong-account, or fabricated-entity error found. Minor items: (a) sections[2].items[0].main describes the briefing as 'classified as needed' where the bill mandates an unconditional 'classified briefing' (invented qualifier); (b) sections[1].items[0].detail labels 2016 subsection (c) 'classified-form provisions' where it in fact defaults to unclassified form; (c) underreported why_unreported asserts the requirement 'rarely appears in press summaries' (extrinsic, unverifiable); (d) likelihoodReason 'lowers the objection surface in the House' is a speculative prediction. None material. Sponsor/cosponsor/Unanimous-Consent method are structural cache/votes[] metadata not present in the bill text.
